name: Elder Thorne
tier_1: Once per game, when a Calamity hits the Prophet's city, one neighbor takes the hit instead.
tier_2: Nature Favor cards cast in his city also give one neighbor +1 Flock.
tier_3: Once per turn, redirect a Calamity aimed at any city in his region to another city in that region.
flavor: He has lived in the old forest longer than anyone can remember.

name: Wren of the Wild Roads
tier_1: When The Prophet Wanders resolves, you choose where Wren goes, not your opponent.
tier_2: Moving Wren within her region is free.
tier_3: Wren can move at the start of any turn without using your Action Phase, and an uncontrolled city she's in gets +2 Flock a turn instead of +1.
flavor: She never sleeps under the same roof twice.

name: Old Marta
tier_1: A seed planted in the Prophet's city yields 1 extra Flock.
tier_2: Once per turn, a seed in any city in her region yields 1 extra Flock.
tier_3: Seeds you plant pay out immediately instead of waiting for your next Economy Phase.
flavor: Every field she blesses comes in heavy.

name: Brother Fallow
tier_1: The Long Fast succeeds on a roll of 2-6 instead of 3-6.
tier_2: Ongoing Harvest Calamities on your cities (Famine, Blight, Drought and similar) end one turn early.
tier_3: His city can't lose more than 2 Flock in a single turn.
flavor: He has fasted so often the hunger no longer frightens him.

name: Halvard the Builder
tier_1: Moving the Prophet costs 1 less Flock (minimum 1).
tier_2: Building a structure or Holy Site in his city costs 1 less Flock.
tier_3: Each structure in his city also gives +1 income.
flavor: He preaches from scaffolding, and the temple rises around him.

name: Ada the Lamplighter
tier_1: Once per game, restore an Idle structure in the Prophet's city for free.
tier_2: Structures in her city can't be destroyed by Calamities (Ruin tokens still apply).
tier_3: When you convert a city, its structures come online right away instead of going Idle.
flavor: Wherever she walks, the lights come back on.

name: Sister Mercy
tier_1: When Healing the Sick resolves, a roll of 3-4 gains 1 Flock instead of nothing.
tier_2: Once per turn, when a Free Will card would cost you Flock, lose 1 less.
tier_3: Once per turn, take a Favor card costing 3 or less from the discard pile into your hand.
flavor: She has sat with more of the dying than any priest alive.

name: Ione the Midwife
tier_1: The first strike this Prophet receives each game is ignored.
tier_2: Each turn, her city gains +1 Flock if it already holds 5 or more of yours.
tier_3: Once per game, if your Prophet or Hero would be removed, they return next turn with 0 strikes.
flavor: Half the city was born into her hands.

name: Kael Thornborn
tier_1: Ambush: once per battle, reroll your die.
tier_2: Hunter's Instinct: he wins ties when attacking.
tier_3: Pack Leader: after winning, his surviving army can attack a neighboring city right away.
flavor: Raised by wolves, people say, and he's never denied it.

name: Sela of the Pines
tier_1: Ambush: once per battle, reroll your die.
tier_2: Forest Cover: when she defends, the first round she loses costs her nothing.
tier_3: Untouchable: she never takes a strike from losing a battle, and an attacker who loses to her loses 1 extra Flock.
flavor: No one has ever caught her in a forest.

name: Garrick the Reaper
tier_1: Supply Lines: once per battle, reinforce your army with up to 2 Flock from reserve.
tier_2: Reaper: when he wins, take 3 of the loser's Flock instead of 2.
tier_3: Scorched Fields: after he wins, the loser's next income is halved.
flavor: He swings a war scythe the way his father swung a farm one.

name: Bryn Hearthkeeper
tier_1: Supply Lines: once per battle, reinforce your army with up to 2 Flock from reserve.
tier_2: Deep Stores: when defending, she can commit Flock from reserve as well as from the city.
tier_3: Siege-Proof: a battle against her lasts at most 3 rounds. If both armies are still standing, she wins.
flavor: She has never let a granary fall.

name: Iron Maren
tier_1: Armory: spend 3 Flock (no Action Phase needed) to add +1 Might or Resolve, max 3.
tier_2: Battering Ram: when attacking, she ignores City Walls, and a win also destroys one structure in the city.
tier_3: War Machine: when attacking, roll two dice and use the higher.
flavor: Her armor was built in the god's own forge, or so she claims.

name: Tobias Steelwright
tier_1: Armory: spend 3 Flock (no Action Phase needed) to add +1 Might or Resolve, max 3.
tier_2: Fortify: once per turn, build City Walls in his city for 2 Flock.
tier_3: Shield Wall: when defending, he wins ties and only loses Flock on a round he loses by 2 or more.
flavor: He fights behind a shield he designed himself.

name: Lio Bloodsworn
tier_1: Field Medics: after a battle, half your lost army (rounded down) returns to the city.
tier_2: Bloodsworn: each time he takes a strike, he gets +1 Might in his next battle.
tier_3: Undying: the first time each game he would be removed, he stays with 2 strikes.
flavor: He has died twice, and come back angrier both times.

name: Ash the Unbroken
tier_1: Field Medics: after a battle, half your lost army (rounded down) returns to the city.
tier_2: Triage: when defending, Field Medics returns all of her lost army, not half.
tier_3: Unbroken: when she wins a defense, the attacker's surviving army becomes yours.
flavor: Every scar on her is a battle she walked away from.
